aboutPreview.title: A small team, deliberately.
aboutPreview.body: TechOn was founded in 2019 to build software properly — the kind that still runs, and still makes sense, years after the launch party. We stay small on purpose: the engineers you meet at kickoff are the ones who write your code, and they stay with it long after it ships.

nova.title: A workforce that never sleeps.
nova.lead: NOVA answers the phone, replies to your messages, books the meeting and updates the CRM. It works at three in the morning, in every language your customers speak.
nova.capabilitiesLead: Twenty-two capabilities, one platform. Turn on what you need and leave the rest.

why.title: Built by engineers who ship.
why.lead: Not a marketplace of freelancers. One senior team, accountable from kickoff to the years after launch.

speed.title: Shipped, not scoped

ownership.title: You own everything

longevity.title: Built to outlast us

process.title: Seven steps. No surprises.

meta.title: About Us
meta.description: TechOn is a software company building AI platforms, mobile applications and enterprise systems from Dar es Salaam, Nairobi and Houston.

hero.title: We build software the way it should be built.
hero.lead: Founded in 2019. Small on purpose, senior by design, and still supporting the first systems we shipped.

who.title: A software company, not an agency.
who.body1: TechOn is a team of engineers and designers working out of Dar es Salaam, Nairobi and Houston. We build AI platforms, mobile applications and the enterprise systems that businesses run their day on.
who.body2: We do not subcontract, and we do not staff projects with whoever is free. The people in your first meeting are the people who build the thing — and who answer the phone two years later when you want to extend it.

mission.title: Make good software ordinary.
mission.body: Too many businesses have been sold systems that are slow, fragile or already abandoned. We exist to change what people expect from the software they pay for: fast, documented, owned by them, and still standing years later.

vision.title: African engineering, held to a world standard.
vision.body: We want TechOn to be proof that software built in Dar es Salaam competes with software built anywhere — measured on craft, reliability and the quality of the thinking behind it, not on price.

values.title: What we hold ourselves to.
values.lead: Six commitments that decide how we work when nobody is watching.

craft.title: Craft over volume
craft.description: We would rather ship fewer things properly than many things adequately.

candour.title: Say the hard thing
candour.description: If a feature is not worth building or a deadline is not real, you hear it from us first.

ownership.title: Own the outcome
ownership.description: The job is not done at handover. It is done when the thing works in production.

speed.title: Move at a real pace
speed.description: Working software every sprint. Momentum is a feature, not a nice-to-have.

security.title: Secure by default
security.description: Encryption, least privilege and audit trails are decisions we make on day one.

curiosity.title: Stay curious
curiosity.description: We read the papers, run the experiments, and adopt the new thing only once it earns it.

leadership.title: The person behind the work.
leadership.lead: TechOn is led by an engineer, which is why the engineering comes first.
leadership.bio: Conrad founded TechOn in 2019 after a decade of building systems for banks, hospitals and logistics operators across East Africa. He still reviews architecture on every project the company takes on.

stack.title: What we build with.
stack.lead: A deliberately small, well-understood toolkit. We add to it slowly and remove from it often.

founded.title: TechOn is founded
founded.description: Two engineers, one room in Dar es Salaam, and a first contract to rebuild a logistics back office.

firstEnterprise.title: First enterprise system
firstEnterprise.description: A hospital management platform that is still in daily use six years later.

mobile.title: Mobile practice opens
mobile.description: Flutter and React Native become a core capability rather than a side offering.

regional.title: Nairobi and Houston
regional.description: Clients across three countries, and the team grows to support them properly.

ai.title: AI becomes a discipline
ai.description: Retrieval systems, document intelligence and the first production voice agents.

nova.title: NOVA AI launches
nova.description: Everything we learned about AI in production, assembled into one platform.

today.title: Today
today.description: Fifty projects delivered, twenty clients, and the first systems we built still running.
